name: field-messages
reviewNotes: Original glyphs reviewed for all 68 records: 43 party-return messages and 25 remaining field messages. Source controls and individual 14-cell lines verified. Together with the live translations these cover every text-bearing record in this block; empty and control-only records remain unchanged.
Original glyphs confirm ボンビラス as a proper name: use editorial transliteration 邦比拉斯, not generic 貧窮世界. キングボンビー is rendered 貧窮大王; these are project translations, not claimed official names.

Not included in v41. All 68 records are copied into field-messages for v42 and passed synthetic native rendering and original relocation comparisons; this reference draft is not added separately to the manifest. Natural party-return routes and every dynamic value remain unverified.
